# versions { #crossrepo.remote.versions }

```python
crossrepo.remote.versions(entry, client=None)
```

List every version of one published file or dataset on GitHub.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**entry**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Entry](`crossrepo.model.Entry`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Entry whose history to read. Its `remote` names the repository.

<code>[**client**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[Client](`crossrepo.github.Client`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Client to read with. Defaults to a new one.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[List](`typing.List`)\[[Version](`crossrepo.model.Version`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Versions newest first.
